rows.description: Crawlee—A web scraping and browser automation library for Node.js to build reliable crawlers. In JavaScript and TypeScript. Extract data for AI, LLMs, RAG, or GPTs. Download HTML, PDF, JPG, PNG, and other files from websites. Works with Puppeteer, Playwright, Cheerio, JSDOM, and raw HTTP. Both headful and headless mode. With proxy rotation.

This GitHub repo is a powerhouse collection of APIs you can start using immediately to build everything from simple automations to full-scale applications. One of the most valuable API lists on GitHub—period. 💪
